description: Get a test plan (TP-*): metadata, linked runs, case count and status summary. Needs a project id (PR-*); no tool lists projects, so get it from the capability functions. Requires a test plan identifier (TP-*). Call listTestPlans first if you do not have it. Creating a test plan or sub-plan, and linking or unlinking test runs, are not available as tools here: use the capability functions (they ask you to confirm first).

project_identifier.description: Identifier of the project (starts with PR- followed by a number).

test_plan_identifier.description: Identifier of the test plan (starts with TP- followed by a number).

name: getTestPlan
